verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own AI-tools page says users can create campaigns from inside an AI chat, which is first-party natural-language operation, though the evidence is one marketing line covering only campaign creation. Analytics AI gives plain-language explanations, but that is natural-language output rather than command input, so it adds little. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control beyond campaign creation (audiences, sending, automations, reporting), technical docs on how the chat integration works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Create campaigns with the AI you already use. Without leaving the chat.
